answer: Each identity holds one onyx-registry slot, self-prices it, and pays 5% tax each epoch; any buyer may take it at that price. Slots trade in the terrace market, so a low price invites buyout. To keep a fake, an attacker must price it above its work value, about 250 credits, paying 12.5 credits tax each epoch; 1,000 fakes pay 12,500 credits tax and lock 250,000 credits. An honest agent pays 12.5 credits for one 250-credit slot and keeps standing, while buyouts raise an umber flag auditors use to recheck prices. Price suppression fails: a 1-credit fake is bought at once and its standing resets.
